model: Inherited unchanged from controller for all three calls; concrete backend model revision is not exposed by the runner
overrides: None (same model and reasoning settings inherited)
tools: Same inherited tool catalog; native Node/Python/Chrome available; local HTTP/browser escalation available to all arms

budget.enforcement: Prompt instructions; runner does not expose a hard per-agent token/time cap. Exact model token usage is unavailable.

arms.guidance: No design skill; no UDI commands; explicitly exclude globally listed skills
Frozen legacy skill at skill/SKILL.md; legacy recommend/search only; no other skills
Updated canonical skill at skill/SKILL.md; no other skills

common_prompt_constraints: Read common task and assigned directory only; execute fully; all writes in assigned directory; no siblings/docs/external context; no dependencies/Git/publication; no subagents; save evidence.json; report factual results and elapsed timing.
shared_environment_corrections: Local listener EPERM: require_escalated succeeded for controller; same option communicated to all arms
Node spawnSync can expose EPERM with status zero: verify nonempty retrieval stdout; communicated to both skill arms
isolation: Fresh contexts and directory copies, identical application input hashes, read restrictions by prompt. Shared filesystem/tool catalog is not a security isolation boundary; no cross-run output was sent to implementing agents.
discovery_limit: Skill entrypoint explicitly routed by condition; this tests agent consumption/application, not implicit discovery in a separately installed Codex/Claude/Cursor/Antigravity host.
comparability_limit: One sample per condition, parallel runs share CPU; prompt-level execution budget rather than hard measured token equality. This is a controlled exploratory comparison, not a blinded causal experiment.
